name: Midas Golden Touch Christmas Edition
review:
Midas Golden Touch Christmas Edition is a snowy version of the 15-line Midas slot, with wilds that boost wins, a feature buy, and a bonus game with sticky wins.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,100x cap and a 96.17% RTP.

Snow-covered columns and festive music give the Christmas edition its own feel.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
